arms.description: Show exact source Picture 1 as the candidate management-team composition
Show exact source Picture 2 as the candidate management-team composition
Show exact source Picture 3 as the candidate management-team composition
Show exact source Picture 4 as the candidate management-team composition

reference_arm_rationale: Picture 4 is the source composition with no substituted faces relative to the four faces shared across all images. All four randomized complete team compositions remain in the action set.
outcome_question: This team includes a high degree of ethnic diversity.
decision_maker: an employer choosing among the four exact candidate management-team compositions for the narrow objective measured by the source
beneficiary: the employer's declared objective of assembling a team perceived as ethnically diverse
utility_rationale: Higher normalized utility means stronger respondent perception that the exact pictured team has a high degree of ethnic diversity. It does not measure team performance, fair hiring, employee welfare, or actual protected identities.
truthfulness_scope: The contract is image-specific. It does not infer or assign any depicted person's protected identity from appearance, and it must not be generalized into a race-composition or quota recommendation.
target_population: U.S. adults represented by the source KnowledgePanel sample and its study-specific weight
weighting_rule: Primary estimator uses positive finite source weight1 in a Hajek mean by XTESS040 arm; unweighted and weight2 analyses are prespecified sensitivities.
missingness_rule: Exclude source Q1 code -1 and missing values; accept only integer values 1 through 7; require positive finite weight1.
primary_estimator: After a separately authorized, recommendation-bound reveal, project only caseid, weight1, XTESS040, and Q1 from the hash-pinned source SAV. Map Q1 to U=(y-1)/6, compute the weight1-weighted Hajek mean by arm, and select the arm with maximum utility.
sensitivity_estimators: unweighted source-data mean normalized utility by XTESS040
source weight2-weighted Hajek mean normalized utility by XTESS040
respondent-race-stratified estimates only under a separately frozen subgroup protocol
bootstrap_procedure: Resample source participants with replacement within randomized arms, preserving each participant's weight, and recompute arm means, effects, winner, and regret using a frozen benchmark seed.
socsci210_mismatch_note: SocSci210 describes eight-person 3/5 or 5/3 Black/White and Asian/White teams and uses a -3..3 response reconstruction. The final source instrument fields four six-person Picture 1-4 teams and a 1..7 outcome. SocSci210 responses must not score this contract.
checkpoint_compatibility: The released Socrates participant_mapping.json lists es4xw as seen. A released Socrates checkpoint evaluation must be labeled training-exposed, never experiment-held-out.
reconstruction_note: The complete final questionnaire and four exact source images were inspected outcome-blind. The SAV dictionary and only XTESS040, weight1, and weight2 structural values established mapping and support; Q1 and all other outcome values remained unopened. The questionnaire preload XTESS042 is reconciled to archived assignment variable XTESS040 labeled Picture Selected.
